fields.timestamp_utc: UTC timestamp of the original observation; do not synthesize missing times
fields.site_id: Source site or station identifier; one independent series per site
fields.pm25_ug_m3: PM2.5 normalized to micrograms per cubic metre
fields.pm10_ug_m3: Optional PM10 normalized to micrograms per cubic metre
fields.co2_kind: measured, equivalent, or null; eCO2 must never be marked measured
fields.quality_flags: List: invalid_range, saturated, duplicate, missing, or source_quality_unknown
fields.transform_version: Version of the deterministic adapter transformation
